title: Restoring Calibration for Aligned Large Language Models

summary.claim: Preference alignment makes LLMs overconfident, partly through preference collapse. Calibration-aware fine-tuning restores calibration in the calibratable regime, and an EM-based ECE regularizer does so in the non-calibratable regime.
summary.condition: Preference-aligned LLMs further fine-tuned on domain knowledge; confidence measured from output probabilities.
summary.gap: (Inferred) Verbalized confidence and how confidence shifts under user pushback are not studied.
